article.title: 名創優品曼谷新店用角色分區及打卡活動串連購物
article.summary: 名創優品披露曼谷CentralWorld的MINISO LAND開店做法，以角色主題分區，配合地圖打卡及禮品換領。
highlights: 公司稱自家角色CHOUCHOU在店內作東南亞首發。
店內有角色商品、毛絨玩具及一般商品區。
article.why: 旅遊零售品牌可讓同一角色出現在展示、互動和換領，並分開量度每個環節。
article.next_step: 為各主題區設一個可追蹤的互動點，再對照登記、到店及兌換數字。
article.detail: 名創優品在曼谷CentralWorld開設MINISO LAND，披露以大型視覺裝置和情境展示串連三類商品區。公司亦稱CHOUCHOU在當地首次面向東南亞市場亮相，店內設地圖打卡及禮品換領。團隊策劃相似門店活動時，可把各區互動、兌換和購買分開記錄。
article.title_en: MINISO connects character zones and check-ins at its new Bangkok store
article.summary_en: MINISO described themed retail zones, a map-based check-in and gift redemption at MINISO LAND in Bangkok's CentralWorld.
highlights_en: The company says its own CHOUCHOU character made its Southeast Asian debut there.
The store has character merchandise, plush toys and general merchandise zones.
article.why_en: Travel retailers can use one character across displays, activities and redemptions, then measure those steps separately.
article.next_step_en: Set one trackable interaction in each zone and compare registrations, visits and redemptions.
article.detail_en: MINISO opened MINISO LAND in Bangkok's CentralWorld and described large displays and themed settings across three merchandise zones. It says CHOUCHOU debuted in Southeast Asia there, alongside a map-based check-in and gift redemption. Teams planning similar store activations can separate zone interactions, redemptions and purchases in their tracking.
